subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: Hosted authenticated review, code-owner protection, stale-approval dismissal, latest-head approval, and admin enforcement retain their behavior; local mode is explicit and never selected as an approval fallback
rationale: The operator accepted a reduced boundary only for the shared-account local Git workflow
fit_criterion: Hosted conformance fixtures retain their verdicts; a failed hosted approval cannot be satisfied by a local receipt; this contract-only amendment and its approved successor design merge independently before a later proposal enables local selection or receipts.
